DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文の前に確認したいことがあると伺いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand there is something you would like to check before ordering.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 卵のアレルギーがあります。焼き魚の定食なら、卵を使わずに作れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 卵アレルギーを伝え焼き魚定食を卵なしで作れるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an egg allergy. Can you make the grilled fish set meal without using eggs?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your egg allergy and ask whether the grilled fish set can be made without eggs. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 付け合わせとたれも含めて厨房に確認します。特に確認してほしい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check with the kitchen, including the side dishes and sauce. Is there anything in particular you want me to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 材料だけでなく、卵料理と同じ鉄板やへらを使うかも聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 卵料理と鉄板やへらを共用するか厨房への確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please ask about the ingredients and also whether they use the same griddle or spatula as for egg dishes.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to check with the kitchen whether the griddle or spatula is shared with egg dishes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 厨房から返事がありました。魚自体に卵は使いませんが、鉄板とへらは卵料理にも使っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-05.translation: The kitchen has replied. No eggs are used in the fish itself, but the griddle and spatula are also used for egg dishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 器具が共用なのですね。別の器具と場所で調理する対応はできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 共用と聞いて専用の器具と場所で対応できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the equipment is shared. Could you prepare it using separate equipment in a separate area?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After hearing the equipment is shared, ask whether separate equipment and a dedicated area can be used. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 専用の調理場所がなく、微量の混入を防げるとはお伝えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-07.translation: We do not have a dedicated preparation area, so we cannot tell you that we can prevent traces of egg from getting into the food.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら魚の定食は注文しません。未開封の水だけ購入することはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 混入を防げないため定食を見送り未開封の水のみ買えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-08.translation: In that case, I will not order the fish set. Could I buy just some unopened water?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decline the set because cross-contact cannot be prevented, and ask whether you can buy only unopened water. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 未開封のボトルはお渡しできます。定食は注文されないとのことですが、ほかの料理もお調べしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can give you an unopened bottle. You said you will not order the set, but would you like us to check other dishes as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今回はほかの料理も頼まず、水一本だけにします。調べた内容を教えてくれて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他の料理も頼まず未開封の水一本に決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-10.translation: This time I will not order any other dishes either; just one bottle of water. It was helpful to hear what you found out.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to order other dishes either and choose just one unopened bottle of water. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 食事の注文は入れていません。こちらが未開封の水です。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-013-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have not placed a food order. Here is your unopened water. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 風が強くなってきました。海沿いの低い通路には今日は入れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-01.translation: The wind is getting stronger. You cannot enter the low walkway along the sea today.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人を待ちながら砂浜でお弁当を食べるつもりでした。砂浜へ下りる階段も使えませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 砂浜で昼食を取る予定を伝え階段の利用可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was planning to eat my packed lunch on the beach while waiting for a friend. Are the stairs down to the beach also closed?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to have lunch on the beach and ask whether the stairs can be used. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 階段の先が規制区域なので使えません。休憩なら、この案内所の屋内席をご利用いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-03.translation: You cannot use them because they lead into the restricted area. If you want to rest, you can use the indoor seats at this information center.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 泳ぐ予定はありませんが、屋内席に変更します。飲食してよい席でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 屋内に変更して飲食できる席か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was not planning to swim, but I will switch to the indoor seats. Is eating and drinking allowed there?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Switch to the indoor seats and check whether eating and drinking are allowed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの席は飲食できます。窓際は満席なので、奥の丸い机へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-05.translation: You may eat and drink in these seats. The window seats are all taken, so please use the round table farther inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 丸い机で食べます。友人に階段の所ではなく案内所へ来てもらうよう送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 丸い机を選び友人にも集合場所の変更を知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will eat at the round table. I will message my friend to come to the information center rather than the stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the round table and explain that you will also tell your friend the meeting place has changed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうしてください。食べ終わった容器は持ち帰りをお願いします。袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. We ask you to take your containers home after eating. Do you have a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持ち帰る袋があります。友人が着くまで、席を一つ荷物で取っておいても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持ち帰り袋を示し荷物で同行者の席を取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a bag to take them home. May I keep one seat for my friend with my belongings until they arrive?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you have a bag for taking your rubbish home and ask whether you may reserve your companion's seat with your belongings. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 混み合っていますので、荷物で席を確保するのはご遠慮ください。着いてから空いている席をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-09.translation: As it is crowded, please do not reserve seats with belongings. We will show your friend an available seat after they arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鞄は自分の足元に置きます。友人には着いたら入口から連絡してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物で席を取らず友人には入口から連絡してもらうと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put my bag by my own feet. I will ask my friend to contact me from the entrance when they arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to reserve a seat with belongings and to ask your friend to contact you from the entrance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。規制区域には近づかず、屋内でゆっくりお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-014-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please do that. Stay away from the restricted area and take your time waiting indoors.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この大鉢をお探しですか。持ち上げる前に、台の上で大きさをご確認いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for this large bowl? Before lifting it, you can check its size on the stand.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 食器棚の段が低いので、高さを測りたいです。家の棚は十一センチしか空いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚の空きが十一センチのため大鉢の高さを測りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-02.translation: The shelves in my cupboard are close together, so I would like to measure its height. There is only eleven centimeters of clearance on my shelf at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you would like to measure the large bowl's height because your shelf has only eleven centimeters of clearance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 大鉢は高さ十二センチです。隣の小鉢は八センチなので、棚に余裕ができます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-03.translation: The large bowl is twelve centimeters high. The small bowl next to it is eight centimeters high, so there would be room to spare on your shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では小鉢を見ます。温め直しに電子レンジを使うので、この小鉢は対応していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小鉢に切り替え電子レンジに対応するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will look at the small bowl. I use a microwave to reheat food; is this bowl microwave-safe?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Switch to the small bowl and ask whether it is microwave-safe. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの小鉢は電子レンジ対応の表示があります。大鉢のほうは対応していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-05.translation: This small bowl is labeled microwave-safe. The large bowl is not.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小鉢なら用途に合います。棚に入らなかった場合、未使用なら交換できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小鉢が棚に入らなかった場合の未使用交換を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-06.translation: The small bowl would suit my needs. If it does not fit on my shelf, could I exchange it if it is unused?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether the small bowl can be exchanged unused if it does not fit on your shelf. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当店では、お客様の寸法違いによる交換は承っていません。高さだけでなく直径も今ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-07.translation: Our shop does not accept exchanges for customers' measurement mistakes. Please check the diameter now as well as the height.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 交換できないなら直径も測ります。棚の奥行きは二十センチで、この小鉢は何センチですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交換不可を受け棚の奥行きを伝えて小鉢の直径を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it cannot be exchanged, I will measure the diameter too. My shelf is twenty centimeters deep; what is the diameter of this small bowl?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After hearing exchanges are not accepted, state your shelf's depth and ask the small bowl's diameter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 直径は十六センチです。取っ手はないので、最大幅も同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is sixteen centimeters in diameter. It has no handles, so its maximum width is the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 高さ八センチ、直径十六センチなら収まります。この小鉢を一つ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 高さ八センチ直径十六センチを確認して小鉢一つを買う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-10.translation: At eight centimeters high and sixteen centimeters in diameter, it will fit. I will buy one of these small bowls.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the eight-centimeter height and sixteen-centimeter diameter and buy one small bowl. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 割れないよう包んでお渡しします。寸法を確かめてくださりありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-015-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will wrap it to prevent breakage before handing it to you. Thank you for checking the dimensions.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この展示は、昔の暮らしの道具を紹介しています。どの道具が気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-01.translation: This exhibit introduces tools used in daily life long ago. Which tool interests you?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この細長い道具です。説明にある「用途」という言葉の意味から教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示道具に関する用途という語の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-02.translation: This long, thin one. Could you start by explaining the word “用途” in the description?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the meaning of “用途,” a word about the exhibited tool. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 用途は、何のために使うかという意味です。この道具は糸を巻くために使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-03.translation: “用途” means what something is used for. This tool is used to wind thread.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 糸を巻く動きを見たいです。展示ケースの道具を動かしてもらうことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 糸を巻く動きを見たいと伝え展示資料を動かせるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to see the thread-winding motion. Could you operate the tool in the display case?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to see the thread-winding motion and ask whether the exhibited object can be operated. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ケース内の資料は動かせませんが、机の上の模型なら一緒に操作できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot operate the object in the case, but we can operate the model on the table together.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 模型で試したいです。手順を忘れないよう、説明板の写真も撮ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 模型で試すことを希望し説明板の撮影許可を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to try the model. May I also photograph the explanation panel so I do not forget the steps?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to try the model and request permission to photograph the explanation panel. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この説明板は撮影禁止の表示があります。内容を手帳に書き留めることはできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-07.translation: This explanation panel has a no-photography sign. You may write down its contents in your notebook.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、糸を巻く順番を手帳に書きます。模型を操作する前に、鞄をどこへ置けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 撮影の代わりにメモを取り操作前の鞄の置き場を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will write the thread-winding sequence in my notebook. Where should I put my bag before operating the model?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Take notes instead of photographs and ask where to put your bag before operating the model. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 足元の荷物棚を使えます。肩に掛けたままだと模型に当たるので、下ろしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can use the luggage shelf by your feet. Please take your bag off your shoulder, as it could hit the model if you leave it there.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鞄を棚に置きました。まず糸の端を固定するところから教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鞄を棚に置き糸の端を固定する手順から教えてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have put my bag on the shelf. Please start by showing me how to secure the end of the thread.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put your bag on the shelf and ask to be taught from the step of securing the thread end. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 糸の端はこちらです。模型で順番に試しましょう。お帰りの際は鞄をお忘れなく。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-016-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the end of the thread. Let us try the steps in order on the model. Do not forget your bag when you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その船の模型は撮影可能です。ただ、後ろの来館者が写り込みそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-01.translation: You may photograph that ship model. However, it looks as though the visitors behind it might end up in your photograph.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 模型の前で家族写真を撮りたいです。人が減るまで待ったほうがいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族写真で来館者が減るのを待つべきか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to take a family photo in front of the model. Should we wait until there are fewer people?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you should wait for fewer visitors before taking a family photo. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お待ちになるなら、通路ではなく床の丸い印の内側へお願いします。三脚はお使いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you wait, please stand inside the round floor marking rather than in the walkway. Will you use a tripod?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三脚は使わずスマートフォンだけです。丸い印の中から横向きで撮れば、人を避けられそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三脚は使わず床の印の内側から人を避けて撮ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-04.translation: No tripod, just a smartphone. If I take a landscape photo from inside the round marking, I think I can keep other people out.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will not use a tripod and will take the photo from inside the floor marking, avoiding other people. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 模型の脇の図面は撮影禁止なので、その部分も画面に入らないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-05.translation: The drawing beside the model may not be photographed, so please keep that out of the frame as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 図面を外すために、模型だけ先に近くから一枚撮ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 禁止図面を写さず模型だけ近くから撮れるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-06.translation: To leave out the drawing, may I first take one close-up photo of just the model?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether you can photograph just the model up close, without including the prohibited drawing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展示台の柵を越えなければ構いません。写真はどのように使うご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is fine as long as you do not cross the barrier around the display stand. How do you plan to use the photos?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族に送るのが目的ですが、自分の公開ページにも載せようか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族への送信と公開ページ掲載を検討していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to send them to my family, but I am also considering putting them on my public page.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you are considering sending the photos to family and posting them on a public page. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 館内での撮影許可と公開利用の条件は別です。公開用なら受付の利用案内で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-09.translation: Permission to take photographs inside and the conditions for public use are separate matters. For public use, please check the usage information at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は家族に送る分だけ撮り、公開は案内を確認するまで見送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日は家族向けだけ撮り公開は利用案内の確認後と決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will take only the photos to send to my family and hold off publishing them until I have checked the information.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to take only family photos today and postpone publication until checking the usage information. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では柵の手前で、人と図面が入らないようお撮りください。よい記念になりますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-017-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take your photos on this side of the barrier, keeping people and the drawing out of the frame. I hope they make a lovely memory.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図の赤い線は工事中の区間です。一周の散歩をご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-01.translation: The red line on the map marks the section under construction. Were you planning to walk a full circuit?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二十分だけ歩きたいです。膝が気になるので、長い迂回になるなら一周はやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二十分の予定と膝の事情を伝え長い迂回なら一周をやめたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only want to walk for twenty minutes. I am concerned about my knee, so if there is a long detour, I will skip the full circuit.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your twenty-minute plan and knee concern, and say you would skip the circuit if the detour is long. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一周には迂回を含めると四十分ほどかかります。池の手前までの往復なら短くできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-03.translation: A full circuit takes about forty minutes including the detour. You can make it shorter by going only as far as the near side of the pond and back.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池の手前までに階段はありますか。下りの階段は特に避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池の手前までに階段があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-04.translation: Are there any stairs on the way to the near side of the pond? I especially want to avoid going down stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether there are stairs on the way to the near side of the pond. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この案内図の太い線は階段のない通路です。池の橋へは進まず、手前のベンチで折り返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-05.translation: The thick line on this map is a route without stairs. Do not continue to the pond bridge; turn back at the bench before it.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 太い線を通って橋の前で戻ります。途中で膝が痛くなったら座れる場所もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 階段のない往復を選び途中の休憩場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will follow the thick line and turn back before the bridge. Are there places to sit along the way if my knee starts hurting?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the stair-free out-and-back route and ask about places to rest along the way. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 途中の花壇の横にもベンチがあります。痛みが出たら無理に池まで進まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is also a bench beside the flower bed along the way. If it starts hurting, do not force yourself to continue to the pond.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 花壇で休むことも考えます。帰りに別の入口へ出ないよう、受付側へ戻る目印を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 花壇で休む可能性を伝え受付へ戻る目印を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will consider resting by the flower bed too. To avoid ending up at another entrance on the way back, could you tell me a landmark for returning toward reception?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention that you may rest by the flower bed and check the landmark for returning to reception. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付の上に黄色い旗があります。帰りは旗を見ながら、来た道をそのまま戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is a yellow flag above reception. On your return, look toward the flag and retrace the same path you came on.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 黄色い旗を目印に往復します。今日は一周せず、膝の様子を見て早めに引き返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 黄色い旗を頼りに一周せず体調に合わせて折り返すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use the yellow flag as my landmark for the walk there and back. Today I will not do the full circuit; I will watch how my knee feels and turn back early.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to use the yellow flag, skip the full circuit, and turn back according to your condition. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 赤い工事区間には入らず、ご自分のペースでどうぞ。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-018-001-SHARED-11.translation: Stay out of the red construction section and go at your own pace. Take care on your way back too.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今は雨のため、池の中央の橋を閉めています。ご見学の時間はどれくらいありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-01.translation: The bridge in the middle of the pond is currently closed because of the rain. How much time do you have to look around?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 迎えが来るまで三十五分です。向こうのあずまやを見たいのですが、橋以外から行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三十五分の制限とあずまやへの別経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have thirty-five minutes until my ride arrives. I would like to see the gazebo over there; can I get there without using the bridge?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention your thirty-five-minute limit and ask about another route to the gazebo. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外側の通路から行けます。ただ、入口からあずまやまで片道十五分ほどかかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can take the outer path. However, it takes about fifteen minutes one way from the entrance to the gazebo.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 往復だけで三十分では、ゆっくり見られませんね。入口に近い屋根付きの回廊に変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 往復所要時間から近い屋根付き回廊へ変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-04.translation: With thirty minutes just for the round trip, I would not have time to look around leisurely. I will visit the covered walkway near the entrance instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Based on the round-trip time, switch to the nearby covered walkway. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 回廊なら近いです。途中に細い石の道もありますが、雨で滑りやすくなっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-05.translation: The covered walkway is close by. There is also a narrow stone path along the way, but the rain has made it slippery.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 濡れた石は避けたいので、舗装された道だけを案内図で示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 雨で滑る石道を避け舗装路を案内図で示すよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to avoid wet stones, so please show me only the paved paths on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to show the paved route on the map, avoiding the stone path that is slippery in the rain. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この太い線の道です。回廊の奥は行き止まりなので、同じ道でお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is the path marked by this thick line. The far end of the covered walkway is a dead end, so please return the same way.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りは同じ道ですね。迎えの車には裏口と言ってしまいましたが、そこから出られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ道で戻ることを確認し迎えに伝えた裏口が使えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I return the same way. I told my driver to come to the back entrance; can I leave from there?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you will return the same way and ask whether you can use the back entrance you told your driver about. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 裏口は管理用で、来園者は使えません。迎えの方には受付側の出口をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-09.translation: The back entrance is for staff use, and visitors cannot use it. Please tell your driver to use the exit on the reception side.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付側の出口に変更すると連絡して、二十分でここへ戻ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 迎えを受付側へ変更し二十分で戻ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will contact them to change the pickup to the reception-side exit, and I will be back here in twenty minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to change your pickup to the reception side and return in twenty minutes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 回廊をご覧になったらこちらへお戻りください。足元に気をつけて、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-019-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please come back here after visiting the covered walkway. Watch your step, and enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 県の総合案内です。お持ちの封筒は住所変更の書類でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the prefectural general information desk. Does the envelope you have contain change-of-address documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 転入届を出しに来ました。市役所だと思って、この建物に入ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転入届を出すため市役所と誤認して入館したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came to submit a moving-in notification. I entered this building because I thought it was city hall.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you came in by mistake, thinking it was city hall, to submit a moving-in notification. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここは県の施設で、市の転入届は受け付けていません。まだ届出は済んでいないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a prefectural facility, and we do not accept the city's moving-in notifications. So you have not submitted yours yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。会社の寮に住み始めたのですが、市の窓口で寮の住所をどう説明すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未届出で会社寮に住み始めたことを説明し住所の伝え方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I have started living in my company's dormitory; how should I explain the dormitory address at the city counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not notified the city yet and have moved into a company dormitory, and ask how to give the address. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お部屋まで特定できる資料を用意して、市の担当窓口に確認してください。会社から住所の案内は来ていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please prepare something that identifies even your room and check with the responsible city counter. Has your company sent you information about the address?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社のメールに寮名と部屋番号があります。ただ、そこに書かれた住所が途中で切れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社メールに寮名と部屋番号はあるが住所が途切れていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-06.translation: The company email has the dormitory name and room number. However, the address written there is cut off partway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the company email contains the dormitory name and room number but the address is incomplete. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不足している部分を会社に確認してから、市へ必要書類をお尋ねになるとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would be best to check the missing part with your company first, then ask the city what documents are required.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住所を補ってもらってから電話します。県のここで書類を預けて市へ送ってもらうことはできませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所を確認してから市へ電話すると決め県での書類取次ができるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will call after having the address completed. Could I leave the documents here at the prefectural desk and have you send them to the city?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to confirm the address before calling the city and ask whether the prefectural desk can forward the documents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 市への取次受付はしていません。書類はお客様がお持ちになり、市の案内に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-09.translation: We do not accept documents for forwarding to the city. Please keep them with you and follow the city's instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書類は自分で持ち帰ります。会社に完全な住所を聞き、その住所と手元の書類を市へ伝えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書類を持ち帰り会社で完全な住所を確認して市へ相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the documents home myself. I will ask my company for the full address, then tell the city that address and what documents I have when I ask for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take your documents home, confirm the full address with your company, and consult the city. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お忘れ物がないよう封筒をお持ちください。まず会社へのご確認から進めてくださいね。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-020-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your envelope so you do not leave anything behind. Start by checking with your company. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の確認画面でお困りですか。確定ボタンはまだ押していませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble on the transfer confirmation screen? You have not pressed the confirm button yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 押していません。家賃を振り込みたいのに、画面の受取人名が請求書の会社名と違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未確定の家賃振込で受取人名が請求会社と違うと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have not. I want to transfer my rent, but the recipient name on the screen is different from the company name on the invoice.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you have not confirmed the rent transfer and that the recipient name differs from the billing company's name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 支店名と口座番号を入力し直す前に、請求書と画面を照合しましょう。数字は一致していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before reentering the branch name and account number, let us compare the invoice with the screen. Do the numbers match?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 支店番号と口座番号は同じです。請求書は管理会社名で、画面は個人の名前になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 支店と口座番号は一致するが会社名と個人名が異なると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: The branch number and account number are the same. The invoice has the management company's name, but the screen shows an individual's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the branch and account numbers match, but the company name differs from the individual's name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 数字が同じでも、名義の違いはこちらで正当だと判断できません。管理会社への確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even if the numbers match, we cannot determine here whether the different account holder name is legitimate. You need to check with the management company.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 振り込む前に会社へ電話します。請求書の新しい連絡先だけを使えばよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 振込前に会社へ電話すると決め新しい連絡先のみでよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will call the company before transferring. Should I use only the new contact details on the invoice?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to call the company before transferring and ask whether using only the new contact details is enough. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更された案内だけに頼らず、以前から確認できている連絡先などで相手を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not rely solely on the changed instructions; verify who you are contacting through contact details you have already confirmed before, for example.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 契約時の連絡先へ確認します。送金をしなければ、いま表示されている手数料も引かれませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 契約時の連絡先で確認し未実行の手数料が引かれるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check using the contact details from when I signed the contract. If I do not send the money, will the fee currently displayed also not be deducted?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check using the original contract contact details and ask whether the fee will be deducted for a transfer not carried out. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この画面は実行前の見積りで、まだ処理されていません。今回は取消で終了できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: This screen is an estimate before execution, and nothing has been processed yet. You can end this transaction by canceling.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では取消を押して、振込は保留します。名義の違いが解決してから改めて手続きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 振込操作を取り消し名義不一致が解決するまで送金を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will press cancel and put the transfer on hold. I will go through the procedure again after resolving the account holder name discrepancy.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Cancel the transfer operation and hold off sending money until the account holder name mismatch is resolved. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 終了画面を確認できました。請求書をお忘れなく。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: I can confirm the closing screen. Do not forget your invoice. Thank you for asking us for help.

DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見学が終わりましたが、何かご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-01.translation: The tour has finished. Do you have any questions?

DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子牛にミルクをあげる仕事も見てみたいです。今から飼育の区画へ入れますか。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 授乳作業の見学に飼育区画へ入れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would also like to see the work of feeding milk to calves. May I enter the animal care area now?
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can enter the animal care area to observe milk feeding. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見学の通路から先は、許可を受けた作業者だけが入れます。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-03.translation: Only authorized workers may go beyond the visitor walkway.

DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。触れ合いの場所だと思っていましたが、勝手に柵を開けず、ここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 柵を開けず許可された通路で待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I thought it was an area for interacting with animals, but I will not open the gate on my own and will wait here.
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will not open the gate and will wait on the permitted walkway. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 作業を見る機会があるか、飼育担当へ確認しましょう。作業体験もご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us ask the animal care staff whether there is an opportunity to watch the work. Would you also like a hands-on experience?

DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は見るだけで構いません。初めてなので、子牛を抱いたり道具を使ったりするつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今回は見学のみで動物や道具に触れないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-06.translation: Just watching is fine today. It is my first time, so I do not intend to hold the calves or use any tools.
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that this time you only want to observe and will not touch the animals or equipment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今は担当が作業中です。後で説明を聞く時間を取りたいですか。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member is working now. Would you like us to arrange time for an explanation later?

DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。どういう仕事か分かってから、次回の体験に申し込むか考えたいです。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当の説明後に次回の体験申込みを考えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. I would like to understand what the work involves before deciding whether to sign up for a hands-on experience next time.
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will consider signing up for a future hands-on experience after hearing the staff member's explanation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明の時間が決まったら、受付からご案内します。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Reception will let you know once a time for the explanation has been decided.

DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡を待ちます。同行した友人にも、牛のいる区画へ自由に入れるわけではないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を待ち友人にも立入り条件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait to hear from you. I will also tell the friend who came with me that we cannot freely enter the area where the cows are.
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for the information and tell your friend the conditions for entering the area too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、受付でお待ちください。本日はご見学ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-AIC-ANJO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please wait at reception. Thank you for taking the tour today. Goodbye.
